speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The book is licensed and the parts are not out. I want the feast before anyone learns a line of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then take the feast, and nothing else. The rolls stay with Garnish.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Two measures. A pavan, Italian, and in a minor key, and I stop. Listen for the count, not for a song.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: What are we doing while it goes?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sixteen bars. Old Capulet's welcome, and Tybalt knowing a Montague's voice under the mask. Then the bass viol drops to a whisper, and the fourteen lines float.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen. Then the viol down. I will write the count in the margin, where Garnish will find it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir. If I come in on it, it goes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Under the note. The whole way. Half voice. You are not singing it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Where is the pillar?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Where you are standing. Palm to palm. Stop when the music stops.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Palm to palm. Half voice. I have it if I stay under.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The welcome is the old man's. The knowing is the cousin's. The lines are ours, and they stop when you stop.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will play the sixteen, and you will speak across them. Nobody here is to learn a speech that is not those fourteen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The fourteen, at the pillar, and then stop. Do not give the cousin a seventeenth bar.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will not go over the note.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Begin.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: There. Now nobody in the yard will hear the hautboys, and everybody will hear the pilgrims.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen bars. I have them. The margin will have them before Garnish boxes the leaf.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Once more, and I will know where my hand is.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more is a second time, and a second time teaches a tune. Once is the count. We stop.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I stayed under. The whole way.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You did. That is the feast until the parts are out.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sixteen, then the whisper, then the pilgrims. If the hautboys creep up, I will put them down.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And he is not to be startled between this and the day the parts come out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody startles him. There is no more of the scene than these bars. I am Egeon at two.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Under the note. I have said the trick, and I will keep it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Keep it. We are done.
